collector_source:
"""Collect completed final-source acceptance without substituting old results."""
from __future__ import annotations
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import ast,contextlib,hashlib,io,json,re,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];runtime=root/'product/.runtime';evidence=root/'docs/validation/evidence'
def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(p,v):Path(p).write_text(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
def sources():return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix():sha(p) for p in sorted([*root.joinpath('product/src').rglob('*.py'),*root.joinpath('product/tests').glob('*.py'),*root.joinpath('scripts').glob('*.py')])}
final=sources();runs={};native={}
for name in ['regression','lama-controlled','lama-natural','vace-controlled']:
 p=runtime/('repair-blend-20261016-'+name+'-v2.json');v=read(p)
 assert v['status']=='succeeded' and v['exit_code']==0 and v['changed_sources']==[] and v['source_sha256_before']==v['source_sha256_after']==final,(name,v['status'])
 assert v['log_sha256']==sha(root/v['log_path'])
 runs[name]=v
 if name!='regression':
  folder=root/v['output_root'];s=read(folder/'summary.json');review=read(folder/'manual-review.json')
  assert s['independent_pixel_checks']['outside_mask_changed_pixels']==0 and s['independent_pixel_checks']['source_alpha_exact']
  assert s['inpainting']['sha256']==sha(s['inpainting']['output']) and s['inpainting']['source']['sha256']==sha(s['inpainting']['source']['path'])
  assert s['inpainting']['mask']['sha256']==sha(s['inpainting']['mask']['path'])
  assert s['inpainting']['worker']['metrics']['blend']['mode']=='harmonic'
  assert s['rights_expected_exit']==7 and s['runtime_network']=='disabled' and s['docker_or_wsl_started'] is False
  native[name]={'record':v,'summary':s,'summary_sha256':sha(folder/'summary.json'),'manual_review':review,'manual_review_sha256':sha(folder/'manual-review.json')}
emptyroot=root/'workspace/repair-blend-20261016-lama-empty-v2';empty=read(emptyroot/'summary.json')
assert empty['status']=='succeeded' and empty['weights_loaded'] is False and empty['decoded_rgba_exact'] is True and empty['source_sha256_before']==empty['source_sha256_after']==final
native['lama-empty']={'summary':empty,'summary_sha256':sha(emptyroot/'summary.json')}
log=(root/runs['regression']['log_path']).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
m=re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests in ([\d.]+)s\s+OK\s*$',log);assert m
sys.path[:0]=[str(root/'product/src'),str(root/'product/tests')]
import unittest
subset=unittest.TestSuite(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName(n) for n in ['test_repair_blend','test_local_inpainting','test_local_vace']).countTestCases()
from ai_ad_editor.cli import main
from ai_ad_editor.runtime import configure_local_runtime
configure_local_runtime()
metadata={'python_source_files_compiled':len(final),'commands':{}}
for p in final:compile((root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'),p,'exec')
for name in ['doctor','capabilities']:
 capture=io.StringIO()
 with contextlib.redirect_stdout(capture):code=main([name])
 value=json.loads(capture.getvalue());assert code==0,(name,value);metadata['commands'][name]=value
from ai_ad_editor.media import ffmpeg_path
import numpy as np
audio_checks=read(runtime/'repair-blend-audio-checks-20261016.json')
def audio(path):return subprocess.check_output([ffmpeg_path(),'-nostdin','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-i',str(path),'-map','0:a:0','-vn','-ar','48000','-ac','2','-c:a','pcm_f32le','-f','f32le','pipe:1'])
r=native['vace-controlled']['summary']['inpainting'];a,b=audio(r['source']['path']),audio(r['output'])
assert len(a)==len(b)>0
delta=np.abs(np.frombuffer(a,np.float32)-np.frombuffer(b,np.float32));peak=float(delta.max());assert peak<=1e-6
audio_checks['vace-controlled']={'canonical_rate':48000,'canonical_channels':2,'samples_per_channel':len(a)//8,'peak_sample_error':peak,'canonical_pcm_bytes_exact':a==b,'source_pcm_sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),'output_pcm_sha256':'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()}
for case in native:
 assert audio_checks[case]['canonical_pcm_bytes_exact'] and audio_checks[case]['peak_sample_error']==0
 native[case]['independent_audio_check']=audio_checks[case]
metadata['skill_audit']=read(root/'research/video-cut-validation.json')
assert metadata['skill_audit']['skill_count']==14 and not metadata['skill_audit']['failures'] and not metadata['skill_audit']['unresolved_markdown_links']
cancelled=[]
for name in ['regression','vace-controlled']:
 p=runtime/('repair-blend-20261016-'+name+'-v1.json');v=read(p);assert v['status']=='cancelled-for-implementation-fix'
 cancelled.append({k:v.get(k) for k in ['kind','status','started_at_utc','finished_at_utc','cancel_reason','exit_code','log_sha256']})
assert sources()==final
payload={'checked_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'functional-passed-broad-quality-unaccepted','implementation_base':runs['regression']['code_base'],
 'implementation_sha256':final,'final_frozen_python_source_count':len(final),'full_regression':{'tests':int(m[1]),'seconds':float(m[2]),'status':'passed','record':runs['regression']},
 'focused_subset':{'tests':subset,'status':'passed-as-subset-of-completed-full-regression','standalone_final_subset_run':False},
 'native_runs':native,'metadata':metadata,'earlier_cancelled_jobs_not_counted':cancelled,
 'prototype_diagnostics':{'observation_reuse_evidence':'docs/validation/evidence/repair-observed-plate-diagnostic-20261016.json','sha256':sha(evidence/'repair-observed-plate-diagnostic-20261016.json'),'product_integrated':False,'formal_model_runs_added':0},
 'runtime':{'native_windows':True,'model_runtime_network':'disabled','runtime_downloads':False,'docker_wsl_virtualization_started':False,'browser_started':False},
 'acceptance':{'selected_pixel_preservation_and_delivery_contract':'passed-for-listed-inputs','natural_structure_texture_temporal_quality':'unaccepted','full_jianying_functional_and_visual_parity':False,'model_and_source_commercial_rights_verified':False,'difference_56':'degraded'},
 'collector_sha256':sha(__file__),'collector_source':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')}
save(evidence/'repair-blend-smoke-20261016.json',payload)
print(json.dumps({'status':payload['status'],'tests':int(m[1]),'test_seconds':float(m[2]),'focused_subset':subset,'frozen_sources':len(final),
 'native_runs':list(native),'vace_psnr':native['vace-controlled']['summary']['controlled_reconstruction']['masked_psnr_after_db']},ensure_ascii=False))
